defects.description: Release credits the full original reservation after dispatch has already consumed part of it, restocking shipped units.

trigger.input: timeout 45s go run ./cmd/stockdesk receive:book:10 reserve:a:book:6 dispatch:a:first:2 release:a balance:book

defects.why_missed: S9(a,d): receive, reserve, partial dispatch, release violates stock conservation. The naive undo oracle returns the original quantity; the contract returns only unshipped units. Partial dispatch and full reservation release are tested separately.

defects.description: Dispatch uses a receipt key without the fulfillment cycle, so reopening an order replays an old receipt instead of shipping newly reserved stock.

trigger.input: timeout 45s go run ./cmd/stockdesk receive:book:20 reserve:a:book:4 dispatch:a:parcel:4 reopen:a:4 dispatch:a:parcel:4 order:a

defects.why_missed: S9(a,d): reserve, dispatch, reopen, dispatch reuses a request identifier in a new cycle. The receipt store correctly deduplicates exact keys and reopen correctly advances the cycle, but their dispatch composition omits that namespace. Tests retry within one cycle and use a fresh request after reopening.
